comment: The 19 of the original 28 anchor questions that survive the corpus change of 2026-08-20, when loom left and rongo entered. THE OLD ANCHOR VALUES DO NOT APPLY: recall@5 0.679 / recall@20 0.786 / MRR 0.476 were measured against a corpus containing loom, and these same questions now compete with different distractors. Phases 2, 3, 4a, 4b and 4c are the closed series those numbers belong to. The new series anchors HERE: recall@5 0.474 / recall@20 0.632 / MRR 0.145, measured on 2026-08-20 and recorded in docs/measurements/2026-08-20-corpus-swap.md. Every later phase must reproduce those three before any number it reports can be compared with anything.
